STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate, white and rectangular-ish with rounded corners (square/rounded square plate). No inner wall visible, flat centre.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: a square plate is typically 20-30 cm; this looks like a medium dinner-size plate, so about 24 cm across.
b) Reference cue: the two bread halves are each roughly 11 cm across (bread slice length ~11 cm). The plate spans about 2.2 bread-half lengths across the long diagonal of the frame, so the plate width is about 22-24 cm.
Reconciled width: about 23 cm (area ~530 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Toasted bagel halves (2 halves, each roughly 9-10 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, cut halves). Each half is about the size of a bread slice; count as 2 pieces at about 60 g each (bagel half, dense bread, ~0.3 g/ml bulk, but counted as standard piece). Total bagel: 2 x 60 = 120 g.
- Cream cheese: two visible mounds, one on each half. Left half has a spread plus a dollop (~ 10 cm² spread at 0.3 cm plus a mound ~3 cm x 2 cm x 1 cm ≈ 6 ml). Right half has a mound ~4 x 3 x 1 cm ≈ 8 ml. Total spread ~ 20 ml x 1.0 = 20 g.
- Cucumber: about 5-6 thin round slices, each ~3.5 cm diameter, ~0.4 cm thick, plus a few hidden: roughly 8 slices x (9.6 cm³ x 0.6 g/ml ≈ 6 g) ≈ 40 g; with bulk approximation ~ 35 g.

Total: bagel 120 g + cream cheese 20 g + cucumber 35 g ≈ 175 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: none beyond the bagel halves; no base layer.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g:
- Bagel (plain, toasted): ~260 kcal/100 g
- Cream cheese: ~340 kcal/100 g
- Cucumber: ~15 kcal/100 g

Energy: bagel 120 g x 2.6 = 312 kcal; cream cheese 20 g x 3.4 = 68 kcal; cucumber 35 g x 0.15 = 5 kcal. Total ≈ 385 kcal.
